info.title: FieldShift API
info.summary: Crop-rotation decision support from NASA Earth observations, USDA soil data and farmer priorities.
info.description:
Fuses NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, MODIS, SRTM and GRACE with USDA SSURGO and the Cropland Data Layer, then simulates and compares crop rotations for one field. Every strategy explains why it was suggested, the evidence, the expected benefits, the information gaps and the risks that need local review.

FieldShift surfaces patterns and possibilities from public data. It supports, and never replaces, the judgment of the farmer and of local agronomists, Extension agents and crop advisers.

get.description: Five real fields with pre-harmonised NASA and USDA observations. Instant and offline.

schema.title: Response List Farms Api V1 Farms Get

post.summary: Build a field live from any coordinate
post.description:
Pulls NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, MODIS NDVI, SRTM, Daymet, SSURGO and the Cropland Data Layer
for the coordinate (a few seconds, cached afterwards) and returns the same overview as a
benchmark farm. The returned `id` works with every other endpoint.

get.description:
Farm definition, soil profile, terrain, 24-year climate summary, satellite series,
the fusion and confidence report, hazard calendar and plain-language insights.

get.summary: Bare-field and seasonal vulnerability of the current rotation
get.description:
Month-by-month hazard x exposure grid for the baseline rotation, plus the MODIS NDVI check
of the assumed crop calendar.

schema.title: Response Get Vulnerability Api V1 Farms  Field Id  Vulnerability Get

get.summary: Live NASA POWER climate summary for any coordinate
get.description:
24 years of daily NASA POWER (MERRA-2 + GPM IMERG) summarised to monthly normals, frost
dates, extremes and trends. Keyless. First call for a coordinate takes a few seconds.

schema.title: Response Options Api V1 Rotations Options Get

post.summary: Compare the current rotation with tailored alternatives
post.description:
Returns at least three strategies, always including the field's existing rotation.
Each carries its scores, month-by-month calendar, and the five explanations: why it was
suggested, supporting evidence, expected benefits, information gaps, and risks needing
local review. Changing only `priorities` is a fast re-rank of cached simulations.

get.summary: Scenario dials, their ranges and ready-made presets

schema.title: Response Presets Api V1 Scenarios Presets Get

post.summary: Re-run strategies under a climate or water scenario
post.description:
Runs each rotation under today's climate and under the scenario with the same models
(crop calendar, water balance, erosion, economics, 24-year weather replay) and returns
both, the change, and any rotation that stops fitting the season or runs out of water.

post.summary: Vary one scenario dial to find where rotations trade places

get.description:
